title: Design System: 免费 API 中文索引

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Entry hover and category/filter state changes.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill status with dot and text, used in the ledger and spec panel.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid #fbbf24; border-radius: 999px; color: #fbbf24; background: color-mix(in srgb, #fbbf24 9%, transparent); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter used for authentication and quota scopes.
components.css: .ds-filter { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #c8ff3d; border-radius: 999px; color: #080c02; background: #c8ff3d; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8ff3d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Export Button
components.description: Outlined lime action for CSV export.
components.css: .ds-export { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #c8ff3d; border-radius: 10px; color: #c8ff3d; background: transparent; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-export:hover { color: #080c02; background: #c8ff3d; } .ds-export:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8ff3d; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A dark, high-signal directory console with a fluorescent lime action color, Space Grotesk lettering, and a live sample call in the first viewport. The interface stays a working tool: search, filters, evidence, and status are always standard and visible.
keyCharacteristics: Deck Ink ground with Signal Lime actions and Signal Sky links.
Live sample panel proves the product with a real curl call.
Category dots and low-tint active rows carry the directory's color spectrum.
Dense ledger rows, flat surfaces, and hairline borders.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Only one high-energy lime fill is visible per functional region; other color is category or status information.

rules.name: The Proof First Rule
rules.body: The first viewport shows a real callable example from the data, not a decorative illustration.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: API entries are ruled rows, not a card grid; hover changes the surface, not the geometry.

dos: Use Space Grotesk and system Chinese fallback together.
Use Tailwind 4 theme tokens for color, type, and radius.
Keep status text and category dots visible.
Let long curl lines wrap on narrow columns.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, glow shadows, or glass.
Don't use category color as a full panel fill.
Don't turn the search deck into a modal or command palette.
Don't remove the live sample from the masthead.
